signals.name: ASML Holding
signals.reasoning: ASML remains the sole supplier of EUV lithography systems, giving it an effectively unassailable position at the leading edge of chip manufacturing. The stock is up modestly today, continuing a steady climb as AI-driven capex from major foundry and chipmaker customers underpins multi-year order visibility. This is a secular growth story, not a trade — the right approach is to accumulate on weakness rather than chase strength.
signals.riskNote: Order timing is inherently lumpy — a soft quarter from a single large customer can swing headline order numbers sharply. Continued US/China export control tightening on EUV tools remains the key overhang on China-facing revenue.
signals.trigger: Structural AI/chip capex cycle; accumulate on any pullback
signals.recommendedAction: Add on dips toward €900–€910. Current holders: hold the core position through the cycle.

signals.name: iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF
signals.reasoning: IWDA remains the portfolio's core diversified holding — broad exposure across roughly 1,500 global large- and mid-cap stocks at a low ongoing cost. There's no single catalyst here; the case is simply to keep accumulating on a regular schedule and let compounding do the work. Deliberately unglamorous compared to the single-stock signals above — that's the point of a core holding.
signals.riskNote: Main risk is a broad global market drawdown — there is no single-stock concentration risk in a diversified index holding like this.
signals.upside: Steady long-term accumulation — 7–8% annualized total return historical average for MSCI World
signals.trigger: Routine scheduled accumulation — no single catalyst
signals.recommendedAction: Continue scheduled contributions. No urgency to time entries for a core index holding.

signals.name: Novo Nordisk B
signals.reasoning: NOVO-B pulled back roughly 4% today on renewed concerns about GLP-1 competitive pressure from rival drug developers and a broader cooling in obesity-drug valuations after an extended run. This reads as a valuation reset rather than a change in the underlying thesis — Novo still holds the leading share of the global GLP-1 market. Not a sell, but not a buy-the-dip yet either: better to wait for the stock to find a base before adding.
signals.riskNote: Competitive pressure in the GLP-1 market is intensifying as rival drug developers gain share. Watch for further multiple compression if competitor trial readouts disappoint over the next quarter.
signals.upside: +1.3% to DKK 552 (analyst consensus) — muted until stabilization confirmed
signals.trigger: Post-selloff pause; awaiting confirmation of a base
signals.recommendedAction: Hold current position. Do not add until price stabilizes above DKK 560 for 3+ sessions. Set alerts at DKK 520 (stop review) and DKK 595 (breakout add level).

signals.name: Bitcoin
signals.reasoning: Bitcoin is up roughly 3% today on renewed momentum, breaking through the €56K resistance zone on above-average volume. The move looks technically constructive, but crypto momentum moves can reverse quickly and this rally hasn't yet been tested by a pullback. Treat this as a "let it run, don't chase it" setup rather than a signal to add aggressively.
signals.riskNote: Bitcoin remains highly volatile — a macro risk-off event or a sharp reversal in risk appetite could trigger a 15–25% drawdown from current levels within days. Position size accordingly.
signals.upside: +9% to €63,500 near-term momentum target if the breakout holds
signals.trigger: Breakout above €56K resistance with rising volume
signals.recommendedAction: Hold current position. Add only in small increments on confirmed pullbacks — avoid chasing the current move. Stop-loss review level at €50,000.
